title: Israel Orders Mass Evacuation of Entire Nabatieh (200,000 Pop.) and Tyre; 31+ Killed in Strikes
detail: Israeli forces issued a mandatory evacuation order for the entire city of Nabatieh — a city of approximately 200,000 people in south Lebanon — for the second consecutive day on May 27, as well as for swathes of the coastal city of Tyre. Residents were ordered to move north of the Zahrani River, approximately 40 km from the Israeli border. At least 31 people were killed in Israeli attacks across southern Lebanon on May 27. The IDF reported striking more than 150 Hezbollah targets in the prior 24 hours, including 15 infrastructure sites in Tyre used to launch attacks, 10 rocket launch sites, and a training camp in the Bekaa Valley. Ground fighting continued around Zawtar al-Sharqiyah and between Zawtar Sharqieh and Yohmor al-Shaqif north of the Litani River. Israeli Sergeant Rotem Yanai, 20, a welfare NCO in the Givati Brigade, was killed when two Hezbollah explosive drones struck the Shomera area on the Israeli side of the border; two reservists were also wounded.

media.caption: Israel orders mass evacuation of Nabatieh and Tyre; 31+ killed in strikes — Al Jazeera May 27

title: UN Records 670 Projectile Movements in 24 Hours — Highest Since April Ceasefire
detail: The United Nations recorded approximately 670 projectile movements in Lebanon on May 27, the highest single-day count since the April 17 ceasefire took effect. UNIFIL expressed deep concern over escalating hostilities, noting the record figure included rockets, drones, and artillery fired by both Israeli forces and Hezbollah. The Security Council's Lebanon monitoring report identified the May 27 surge as evidence of a breakdown in the ceasefire framework. The record came as Israel issued mass evacuation orders for Nabatieh and Tyre and as IDF forces engaged Hezbollah in ground combat north of the Litani River for the second consecutive day. Over 1,000 Hezbollah drones and 700+ rockets had been fired since the April 17 ceasefire, according to Israeli security analyses.

media.caption: UN records 670 projectile movements in Lebanon — highest since April ceasefire — Security Council Report
